scoring.planted: deterministic — a planted entry counts as found when the report names `file` and at least one token from `match`
scoring.traps: grader — deciding whether a report *complained* about a legitimate import needs judgement; `match` only locates the passage

planted.fix: Collapse toward routes.ts -> a thin service; add the repository on the second consumer of a query. workspace/routes.ts (34 lines, one select) is the precedent for not wrapping.

planted.fix: A Zod contract in @devdigest/shared plus pure functions, the shape agents/helpers.ts and smart-diff/classify.ts already use.

planted.fix: Flat module files. agents/ is the shape to copy: routes.ts -> service.ts -> repository.ts + helpers.ts.

traps.why_legitimate: A repository may import drizzle-orm and db/schema.
Entity/row -> DTO mapping in helpers.ts is the prescribed home.

not_scored.why: OA-APP-004 tells NEW services to take narrow ports, and reserves 'not a refactor target' for the three named existing services. TagsService is new, so flagging it is legitimate and not flagging it is defensible. Score it neither way.

notes: This case contains NO dependency-rule violation. Every import points inward and depcruise is green, so a reviewer who only runs the gate passes the patch. A generic clean-architecture reviewer will praise all three planted items — measured 2026-08-21, the isolated_without_skill arm demanded MORE layering (a TagsRepositoryPort) and praised the entity.
